hotels.description: The Raffles name transcends expectations at this tropical barefoot paradise nestled in East Africa's enchanting Seychelles. Elegant pool villas cascade down an emerald hillside on Praslin Island, the archipelago's paradise isle - a haven where nature orchestrates its most breathtaking performance. Five distinctive restaurants and bars ensure that island seclusion never means sacrificing sophistication. Savour alfresco dining at Losean Restaurant, where panoramic views of the neighbouring Curieuse Island accompany every bite, or immerse yourself in the artistry of Japanese cuisine at The Sushi Room. Beyond your private oasis, the resort's magnificent infinity pool beckons, where laid-back culinary delights and expertly crafted tropical cocktails await beneath swaying palms. In a paradise this extraordinary, complete rejuvenation becomes inevitable. Surrender to indulgent treatments at the Raffles Spa, find your centre at the ocean-view yoga pavilion, or invigorate your senses in the state-of-the-art fitness centre. Beyond the resort's embrace, world-renowned beaches, pristine national parks, and an ocean brimming with spectacular marine life invite endless discovery.
